notes: New 'Text effects' presets gallery — ready-made caption looks so you don't have to build a style from scratch. Each scene's main text gets an ✨ Effects button that opens a gallery of 8 one-click presets (Classic box, Bold block, Neon glow, Soft shadow, Outline, Highlight reveal, Wipe bar, Pink neon). Each preset bundles a style + colours + an animation (including the new Reveal). Click one to apply it to that scene, or tick 'Apply to all scenes' to style the whole video at once. Presets apply through the same /update-scene-texts path as Paste Style — a partial update, so your font size, position and text are left untouched — then the editor refreshes. The from-scratch flow and every individual knob still work for fine-tuning afterwards. index.html only (presets just set fields the Caption render already supports); a browser hard-refresh picks it up.
